title: Atomify examples
description: An example library for Atomify. Open it with https://andeplane.github.io/atomify?examplesUrl=<url to this file>.

title.description: Heading of the example library in Atomify.

descriptionFile.description: Optional Markdown file shown above the examples, relative to examples.json.

baseUrl.description: Optional. Prefix for every relative path. Leave it out so paths resolve relative to examples.json, which keeps forks and local servers working without edits.

id.description: Unique id. By convention also the folder that holds the example's files.

description.description: Short text shown on the example card.

analysisDescription.description: Optional Markdown shown in the generated analysis notebook (used when the example has no notebook of its own).

imageUrl.description: Thumbnail, relative to examples.json (or an absolute URL).

inputScript.description: fileName of the LAMMPS input script to run. Must be one of the files.

analysisScript.description: Optional fileName of the notebook to analyse runs with. Should be one of the files.

fileName.description: Name the file gets in the Atomify project.

url.description: Where to download it, relative to examples.json (or an absolute URL).

content.description: Inline file content, as an alternative to url.
